Class Iti104ResourceProvider

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.FhirProvider
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.AbstractPlainProvider
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.AbstractResourceProvider
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.iti104.Iti104UpdateResourceProvider
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.iti104.Iti104ResourceProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
IResourceProvider, Serializable
public class Iti104ResourceProvider extends Iti104UpdateResourceProvider
Resource Provider for the Patient Identity Feed FHIR [ITI-104] transaction of a Patient Identifier Cross-reference Manager that supports the Remove Patient Option. In addition to the conditional update of Iti104UpdateResourceProvider, it accepts the conditional delete (DELETE Patient?identifier=system|value) of the Remove Patient message. The route then receives the Identifier of the patient as body.

This is the default provider of the transaction.
